fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded checkpoint where the dedicated truck access road meets the truck yard at the SE corner; canopy structures span the inbound/outbound lanes with a striped channelizing median and painted directional arrows.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small booth-footprint structure with canopy spanning the lanes at the gate checkpoint (~39.0801,-78.1506), set beside the truck lanes — distinct from the main DC building.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a physical guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approximately 2 inbound lanes through the gate canopy; 2 outbound. Counted from z20/z21 satellite — moderate confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and a deep curving access road from the public road give ample paved width and queue depth to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The dedicated access road from the public-road stop sign curves ~250m+ to the gate, then opens into a long truck court — easily holds 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: dock banks with trailers backed in on both long faces (NW and SE), physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock with dock doors along both ~600m long building faces; well over 50 doors total. Count is an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long rows of parked trailers (no tractor) line the NW truck court and additional parking near the NE end — 50+ band.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Standalone DC on the forested edge of Winchester VA, surrounded by woodland and farmland with only a Walmart and scattered residential nearby — edge-of-town/rural setting.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from the developed/paved-and-fenced footprint (building + both truck courts + trailer lots); the forested parcel envelope is larger.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved apron / access-road width outside the gate where a truck can wait; a truck was observed staged on the access road in Street View.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved yard area inside the gate before the dock aprons.
